controls.label: Shape
controls.title: Radar shape model
controls.summary: Shape from radar observations. The gray grid marks missing optical imagery; lighting shows the model.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Color shows source-model radius minus a 0.165 km reference sphere, transferred from the closest point on the full original triangular surface. This preferred radar reconstruction is not an independent topographic survey or gravitational height map. Its polar dimension is weakly constrained, and a thicker alternative fits comparably. Ambiguous or out-of-range samples retain the shared grid.
controls.title: Shape-derived radial height
controls.summary: Radar height relative to a 165 m sphere. The polar thickness is uncertain; a thicker model also fits.
